text:
GENERATE BURST KL-5-SE — Run C-9 P4 (Matt M3: redo the under-rotated directions), direction SE. task_id "KL-5-SE".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the approved knight, painted in the hand of a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript, background flat green). KEEP THE PAINTER'S HAND exactly: line, hatching, uneven washes, gouache-like steel with its small dark pits, worn pigment; the blue tabard with gold cross-crosslets and gold bands, loose cloth, short open side flaps, red lining; the helm; the plate; the pollaxe (flared axe blade with a little brass, hammer back, top spike). IMAGE 2 is a GEOMETRY-ONLY guide: a different character in a DIFFERENT style, already turned to direction SE. Take from it ONLY how far the body, feet and head are rotated and which side the right-hand item lands on (his pollaxe goes where her staff is). Copy NOTHING else from IMAGE 2: not its line, colours, smoothness or finish. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 1: do not re-render, smooth, sharpen or restyle.

Show him facing the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT: turned a full 45 degrees to screen-right from facing the viewer. The previous attempt was UNDER-ROTATED; turn the WHOLE body — feet, hips, chest and helm together — to match IMAGE 2's rotation. The camera does not move (same elevated view as IMAGE 1); the light does not move (soft, from screen upper-left). NO MIRRORING: the pollaxe stays in his ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand, upright, butt on the ground; the tabard heraldry keeps its own layout. Same rest pose, size, proportions and framing as IMAGE 1; full body, feet visible, centred; flat uniform pure #00ff00 background.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if the rotation still falls short of IMAGE 2, the pollaxe changed hands, the knight was restyled, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy the output to out/KL-5-SE.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KL-5-SE"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (the approved knight; preserve the painter's hand)
IMAGE 2 — GEOMETRY-ONLY: how far to rotate to SE and the right-hand item side (a different character in a different style; copy nothing else)
